description: Built-in that applies enter/leave classes to a single element toggled by `v-if`, `v-show`, `:is` or `key`.
Classes describing the hidden state at the start of enter and the end of leave.
Classes present during the whole phase; put the CSS `transition` here.
Waits for the leaving element before inserting the entering one.
Animates keyed `v-for` lists, with an optional `tag` wrapper and `*-move` class for reorders.
